customer_concentration.note: No % disclosed. 10-Q Q2'26: usage reduction from largest customer (AI-native) starting Q3'26 'may cause a deceleration'. FY25 10-K: AI-native cohort incl. largest customer = ~7pp of Q4'25 YoY growth

notes: Revenue is from XBRL; Q4 values are FY minus 9M. Revenue model is usage (judgment call): Datadog sells subscriptions with committed minimums, but much revenue is consumption above commitments or on-demand. Customers 'optimize' usage (2022-23 cloud-native, now AI-native cohort), so visibility is consumption-like. Q3'26 guide 1,140 implies only +1.7% QoQ, reflecting the largest customer's usage cut from Q3'26 (10-Q 2026-08-06), but the FY26 guide was raised to $4.45-4.47B. Not tagged guidance_cut. Gross margin is non-GAAP 79.6% (GAAP 79%). TTM (Q3'25-Q2'26): OCF 1,229.0, capex 156.3 (PP&E + capitalized software), FCF 1,072.8 on revenue 3,966.7. Net cash = cash 435.0 + marketable securities 4,550.5 - 2029 convertible notes carrying 985.5 ($1.0B principal) at 6/30/26; operating leases excluded. NRR: the 10-Q gives trailing-12-month dollar-based net retention in the 'low-120%s', entered as 120 (lower bound). ttm_pe uses non-GAAP diluted EPS after Datadog's non-GAAP tax adjustment (prior year recast on the same basis): 0.55+0.59+0.60+0.65=2.39 vs 0.46+0.49+0.46+0.46=1.87. Price $277.22 at the 2026-10-02 close.
